name: DL-19C blaster pistol
description: The DL-19C blaster pistol was a model of blaster pistol manufactured by BlasTech Industries. Equipped with a stun setting, it cost 450 credits. Unlike its predecessor, the extremely popular and successful DL-18 blaster pistol, the DL-19C was designed as a specialized and highly adjustable weapon aimed at a much more niche market. The design team chose to elevate customizability above all else, including the power, accuracy, durability, and capacity that most weapon engineers strove for.
